title: Integrating Fairness and Model Pruning Through Bi-level Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2312.10181v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deep neural networks achieve high predictive performance but often require substantial computational and storage resources, which motivates model compression techniques such as neural network pruning. Conventional pruning methods, however, can introduce or amplify algorithmic bias and produce disparate outcomes across demographic groups. We study fair model pruning, which seeks sparse models that satisfy fairness criteria while maintaining predictive performance. We characterize fairness using both group accuracy disparity and differences in compression-induced accuracy degradation across demographic groups. We propose a framework that jointly optimizes pruning masks and model weights under fairness constraints, thereby integrating accuracy and fairness into the compression process. translated_title: 通过双层优化整合公平性与模型剪枝
translated_abstract: 深度神经网络具有很高的预测性能，但通常需要大量的计算和存储资源，这推动了神经网络剪枝等模型压缩技术的发展。然而，传统的剪枝方法可能会引入或放大算法偏见，导致不同人口群体之间产生差异化的结果。我们研究了公平模型剪枝，旨在获得既满足公平性标准又保持预测性能的稀疏模型。我们通过群体准确率差异以及压缩所导致的各人口群体准确率下降程度差异来刻画公平性。我们提出了一个在公平性约束下联合优化剪枝掩码和模型权重的框架，从而将准确性和公平性整合到压缩过程中。我们将公平剪枝形式化为一个受约束的双层优化问题，并推导出一种高效的优化方法。在多个……（此处摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 本文提出一种基于双层优化的公平模型剪枝框架，在公平性约束下联合优化剪枝掩码与模型权重，使压缩后的稀疏模型在保持预测性能的同时兼顾跨群体公平性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a fair model pruning framework based on constrained bi-level optimization that jointly optimizes pruning masks and model weights, producing sparse models that maintain predictive performance while ensuring fairness across demographic groups.
